Comparison

Alex & Lia and the alternatives

Web agency, freelancer or do-it-yourself platform: each option has its place. At Alex & Lia, two things matter: quick changes and a fair price.

Alex & LiaWeb agencyFreelancerDo-it-yourself platform
Who does the workLia, the AI, for the automatic tasks. Alex, a human, checks and sorts everything.A team, on quoteOne person, depending on their scheduleYou, with templates
Build price€250 to €500, fixed priceOn quoteOn quote, depending on the providerIncluded in the subscription, plus your time
Monthly price€5, €15, €30 a month, depending on the planMaintenance contract, on quoteDepends on the provider, often an extraMonthly subscription, plus optional apps
Timeframe3 to 5 days for a page, 1 to 2 weeks for a showcase website, 2 to 3 weeks for a shopDepends on the team’s scheduleDepends on the providerAs soon as you have finished
ChangesQuick and included: by Lia or by Alex, your choiceOn quote, or in a contractOn quoteYou do them
PriceFair and shown upfront: nothing hidden, no quotesOn quoteOn quoteSubscription shown, extras on top

The prices of the other options depend on the provider and the project: I do not put figures on them here. Alex & Lia prices are those on the plans page.

Who is each option for?

The web agency

A full team: project manager, designer, developer. Ideal for a big project with a budget to match. The price and timeframe depend on the quote.

The freelancer

One person who does everything. The quality depends a lot on who you choose. Changes and follow-up are often on quote, when the freelancer is available.

The do-it-yourself platform

You build your website from templates, for a monthly subscription. You do the work, the updates and the SEO yourself.

Alex & Lia

A fair, fixed price and quick changes. Lia, the AI, changes and updates your website from your client area. Alex checks and sorts everything. For very big projects, I point you to an agency.

Quick changes

Opening hours, a price, a piece of news: Lia, the AI, prepares the change in a few minutes, shows you the preview, then puts it live as soon as you say yes. For anything that needs a human eye, it is Alex, within 72 hours. At an agency or with a freelancer, the same request often involves a quote and a wait.

Why my prices are lower

I use AI to code faster. It does not replace a real developer, but for a showcase website or a small shop, it saves me many hours. Fewer hours means a lower price for you. The details are on the my method page.

What you do not do yourself

With a do-it-yourself platform, the website is never finished: you have to learn the tool, choose the settings, do the updates, write for Google. With Alex & Lia, you say what you want: Lia handles the automatic tasks, Alex the rest. You keep your time for your business.

When I will tell you to go elsewhere

A custom app, specialist business software, a catalogue of thousands of products: these projects need an agency or an experienced developer. I will tell you from our very first conversation.

Your questions about the comparison

Why are you cheaper than an agency?

Because I work differently. AI helps me code faster, and I have no premises to pay for and no team to run. I keep to simple projects that I know how to do well. For a big project, an agency is still the right choice.

How is it different from a do-it-yourself platform?

Who does the work. On a platform, you build the website, update it and write for Google, often in the evening. With me, you describe what you want and I do it. You have no tool to learn.

And compared with a freelancer?

A freelancer builds your website, then every change is negotiated when they are available. My plan takes over from there: hosting, backups, updates and your changes are included every month. You know the price in advance.

If I leave, can I take my website with me?

Yes. The domain name is yours and can be transferred wherever you like. I also give you the website files, so you can host it elsewhere. Nothing ties you down.

Shall we look at your project?

Build your website in two minutes, or ask your questions through the contact form.
